meta.document: Metro Nashville & Davidson County FY2027 Budget
meta.title: Nashville — the money trail
meta.note: Nashville and Davidson County are one consolidated metropolitan government (since 1963) — one budget for the city and the county together. This is the tax-supported operating budget for FY2027, $3.85 billion, grouped by function. It is the Mayor’s Recommended figures (the footing table Metro publishes); the Council-adopted budget was about $1.3M higher — the exact adopted ordinance is on the docket. Metro Water Services is a separate self-supporting utility, outside this total. The property tax rate is $2.782 per $100 across the county (the urban core pays $2.814). Every function figure ties to Metro’s budget book and foots to the dollar.
